statement: There exists a smooth real space sextic with 120 real tritangent planes and three real contact points on every plane, attaining the maximum real-plane count.

source.location: Section 11, Example 11.2 and its proof, printed pp. 66–68; Theorems 1.3–1.4 supply the lifting framework.
source.version: arXiv:2512.24277v1, submitted 30 December 2025; PDF internally dated 1 January 2026. Exact cited version freshly retrieved 4 November 2026.

notes:
This is the distinct tropical construction, not a second attribution of the 2018 construction. The same source also constructs 64 totally real tritangents for a different topology. Real plane coefficients and real contact points are distinguished throughout.

The construction uses tropical lifting in Example 11.2 and Theorems 1.3–1.4.
scope: Smooth algebraic space sextics satisfying tropical genericity hypotheses; totally real tritangent planes.
